$comment: MACHINE-READABLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Final UX Loop campaign state. Owner-decided 2026-08-06 (PR #848, gate b). The generated work map (scripts/agent/status.mjs --html) reads THIS FILE and nothing else for campaign and slice state, so the map can never disagree with the program. docs/program/final-ux-loop.md keeps the prose -- the rationale, the rules of engagement, the running program log -- and section 4 stays the human-readable campaign list. A self-test (scripts/agent/status.test.mjs, wired into CI as of 2026-08-29 -- see the 'program-state-self-test' job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) fails the build if: this file and final-ux-loop.md section 4 disagree on campaign ids, names, or states; a state is used that isn't declared; a campaign's slices are not sequential (a slice can't be merged/done while an earlier one in the list still isn't); or a merge commit's own message claims a campaign-Sslice pair that this file's slice list doesn't list (git history vs. this file, not just doc vs. doc). That last check is what actually catches a slice row going missing, which id/name/state agreement with the prose doc cannot -- both docs can under-list the same slices in lockstep and still 'agree'. Update this file in the same PR that changes a campaign's state.
